# Table styling (compact)

Goal: a dense table style (minimal chrome, still readable).

| Feature | Value | Notes |
|-|--|------|
| padding | small | Less whitespace, more rows per page. |
| grid | minimal | Subtle horizontal rules only. |
| header | emphasized | Clear header without heavy borders. |
